mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD AS payment_method, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(ACTUAL_AMOUNT * 100 AS BIGINT)), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders_legacy WHERE MERCHANT_ID = #{storeId} AND CREATE_TIME >= #{startTime} AND CREATE_TIME < #{endTime} AND ORDER_STATUS IN (1, 4) AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY PAYMENT_METHOD ORDER BY PAYMENT_METHOD
